extracted.intended_audience: researchers in medicine and health sciences (investigators studying knee osteoarthritis, synovial-fluid biomarkers, and translational cell/secretome therapies); OSF registrants preparing scoping review protocols
extracted.subtask_description: Registration/description of a PRISMA-ScR scoping review that (1) synthesizes synovial-fluid IL-6 values quantitatively and (2) maps translational evidence for umbilical-cord MSC secretome / small extracellular vesicle therapies, with associated evidence maps and reporting checklists.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of PRISMA-ScR for scoping review
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The project is explicitly framed as a PRISMA-ScR scoping review; implies following PRISMA-ScR reporting items and methods appropriate for scoping reviews rather than systematic reviews.

rubrics_metrics.name: Quantitative distributional synthesis of reported SF IL-6 values
rubrics_metrics.description: a quantitative distributional synthesis of reported SF IL-6 values
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Perform a quantitative synthesis focused on the distribution (not just point estimates) of synovial-fluid IL-6 measurements reported in the literature; output includes an IL-6 evidence map.

rubrics_metrics.name: Synthesize role of synovial-fluid IL-6 as inflammatory endotype
rubrics_metrics.description: the role of synovial-fluid IL-6 as a candidate inflammatory endotype in knee osteoarthritis
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluate evidence supporting SF IL-6 as an inflammatory endotype — i.e., whether IL-6 levels define a biologically distinct, clinically relevant subgroup; map evidence and consider implications for responder enrichment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Map translational evidence for UC‑MSC secretome and sEV therapies
rubrics_metrics.description: the translational evidence for umbilical-cord mesenchymal stromal cell (UC-MSC) secretome and small extracellular vesicle therapies
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Collect and synthesize translational (preclinical and clinical) studies of UC-MSC secretome and small extracellular vesicle (sEV) interventions for knee OA and produce an evidence map summarizing the state of translational support.

rubrics_metrics.name: Produce IL-6 evidence map
rubrics_metrics.description: Outputs include an IL-6 evidence map
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Create an evidence map that summarizes the quantity, distribution, and characteristics of studies reporting synovial-fluid IL-6 in knee OA.

rubrics_metrics.name: Produce MSC/secretome evidence map
rubrics_metrics.description: Outputs include an MSC/secretome evidence map
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Create an evidence map summarizing studies of umbilical-cord MSC secretome and sEV therapies, including preclinical and translational/clinical evidence, intervention characteristics, and outcomes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Include a MISEV-IA reporting checklist
rubrics_metrics.description: Outputs include ... an MISEV-IA reporting checklist
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide or adapt a MISEV-IA (Minimal Information for Studies of Extracellular Vesicles - in Arthritis?) reporting checklist to standardize reporting of secretome/sEV studies; use it as part of synthesis and reporting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Develop responder‑enrichment algorithm using cohort‑median SF IL‑6 rule
rubrics_metrics.description: a responder-enrichment algorithm using a cohort-median SF IL-6 rule
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Define and justify an algorithm to enrich trial cohorts for likely responders based on synovial-fluid IL-6 (e.g., using cohort-median cutoffs); include method and rationale as an output of the review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Register protocol per OSF guidance for scoping reviews
rubrics_metrics.description: Protocol registered prospectively/retrospectively per OSF guidance for scoping reviews (PROSPERO does not accept scoping reviews).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use OSF registries for scoping review protocol registration following OSF guidance; note that PROSPERO does not accept scoping reviews, so OSF registration is the appropriate route.
